description: Window, event and lifecycle access only. The renderer reaches the daemon through this crate's own commands, and reaches media through the clipmill-media:// scheme this crate serves — a scheme that answers only files the daemon authorized, named by an artifact's own descriptor, for a project that published it. The filesystem, shell and HTTP plugins are deliberately absent from Cargo.toml, so there is no capability that could grant them and no code path to re-enable them at runtime.
